data: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.
This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.
Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.
Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex.
Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.
Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.
Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.
Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.
Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.

Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.
Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.
When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.
After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.
Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.
Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs.
The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it.
Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.
Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.
Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.
Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed
Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.
Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.
While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.
Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.
Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time
Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay.
Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.
Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
+2m Radius and +18.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling
Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.
All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers
300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.
Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage
Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet
Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.
+1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
+25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime
Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies.
After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early.
Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s
Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.
McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.
Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15.0 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.
Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.
Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
+2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage.
If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.
+60 Damage & On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.
After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.
Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead.
Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 16s
Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.
-14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.
Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.

Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage.
There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks
On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks
Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.
+3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s
+7.0% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling
Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence.
Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow.
After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet

Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow.
Can be shot to detonate early.
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.
The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
Send out a luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path.
Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.
Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies.
Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup
Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize.
Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
All Summons now apply Essence Theft
On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.
Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.
Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
+4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration
Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
+70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.
Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
Vitality investment tree bonus reverted back to % base hp increase rather than raw constant bonus (back to how it was set up in december) Hero health…
